sample_descriptions.description: The track has a moderate tempo of 120 BPM, common in house and disco-influenced genres. The track features very dark and bass-heavy timbres with minimal high-frequency content. Most of the sonic energy is concentrated in the low frequencies (sub-bass and bass). The sonic character is a balanced mix of tonal and percussive elements. The track is loud and compressed, typical of club-ready dance music

The track has a fast tempo of 150 BPM, suggesting hard techno, psytrance, or hardstyle. The track features very dark and bass-heavy timbres with minimal high-frequency content. Most of the sonic energy is concentrated in the low frequencies (sub-bass and bass). The sonic character is mostly tonal with some percussive transients. The track is very loud and heavily compressed, maximizing energy for peak-time sets
